heading: Financial services & insurance use cases
intro: Every use case comes from a real Fruition client engagement, with the client's name withheld. Select "See the build" for the process diagram, boards, automations and integrations.

faq.question: What do financial services & insurance organisations build on monday.com with Fruition?
faq.answer: This page shows 13 financial services & insurance use cases. The most common are integrations & migration (9), CRM (8), operations & ERP (6), most often for sales & CRM, finance & procurement, operations & delivery teams.

faq.question: How long does a financial services & insurance monday.com build take?
faq.answer: The most common timeframe for a complete financial services & insurance build is 3 to 6 months. Phased programs run longer, with later phases added once the core build is adopted.

faq.question: Which systems do financial services & insurance builds integrate with?
faq.answer: The integrations that come up most often in financial services & insurance use cases are Outlook, Xero, Make, Microsoft 365 / Teams, Stripe, Microsoft Outlook.

faq.question: Does Fruition build AI agents for financial services & insurance?
faq.answer: Yes. 1 of the financial services & insurance use cases on this page include an AI step. Examples: AI-powered auto-replies for routine enquiries (targeting 20% automation rate).
